active_decisions.decision: Renewed: Upstream pip fix for CVE-2026-8643 still unpublished (latest pip remains 26.1.2, patch only in master). pip is the build-environment installer scanned via uv pip freeze, not a shipped runtime dependency; exploitation requires installing a malicious wheel under elevated privileges, which the lockfile-pinned pipeline does not do — outside threat model. Operator-approved renewal 2026-07-17 (2nd renewal).
active_decisions.followUpAction: Remove .snyk ignore and this acceptance once pip publishes a fixed release for CVE-2026-8643; re-run snyk to confirm green.
